title: Detecting Frames in News Headlines and Lead Images in U.S. Gun Violence Coverage

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting news frames (e.g., Politics, Mental Health, Race/Ethnicity, Gun Control) from article headlines and lead images to identify the perspectives and angles news media use to structure their reporting and potentially influence public opinion.

Evaluating the representation of various racial groups in news headlines and lead images by calculating the percentages of their mentions and portrayals, and analyzing their depicted roles (e.g., victims, perpetrators, politicians) to identify representational disparities.
